notes: All citations are file:line into the frozen app at commit eee783057ec28d28fb36ec05484de9b4b40ceb9c.
No authorization exists anywhere except the approve/reject role gate. Do not infer VIEWER restrictions, archival-state restrictions, or approval policy on other paths.
Execution evidence is supplied by test-engineer/verifier; all test IDs here are planned.

methods.POST: params username,password; authenticate via plaintext SQL compare (PersonDao.java:16-29); success -> session attr user, 302 /tasks (LoginServlet.java:23-35); failure -> 200 re-render login.jsp with error 'Invalid credentials' (LoginServlet.java:28-31)

routes.validation: none server-side beyond the DB lookup; null params simply fail the lookup

methods.GET: params status,assignee,sort; delegates to TaskDao.search (TaskListServlet.java:24-32); forwards tasks.jsp with statusFilter and sortBy attrs (TaskListServlet.java:34-37)

filters.status: exact-match WHERE t.status = ? when non-empty (TaskDao.java:44-47); any unknown value yields empty list, no error
filters.assignee: empty string treated as no filter; non-numeric -> HTTP 500 NumberFormatException (TaskListServlet.java:31)

sortTokens.priority: semantic CASE HIGH=0,MEDIUM=1,else 2, then t.updated_at DESC (TaskDao.java:158-161)
sortTokens.title: t.title, t.id (TaskDao.java:165-167)
sortTokens.unknown-or-missing: falls back to default t.updated_at DESC; sort token is whitelisted, never concatenated (TaskDao.java:56,154-172)

methods.GET: optional id param: task attr set via findById else blank new-task form; always loads projects + people for selects (TaskFormServlet.java:26-35); unknown id renders 'New task' (task-form.jsp:27 c:otherwise); non-numeric id -> HTTP 500
methods.POST: create when id absent, edit when id present (TaskFormServlet.java:65-72)

validation.title: required after trim -> 200 re-render with 'Title is required' (TaskFormServlet.java:41-48,85-87)
validation.projectId: must be present and exist -> 200 re-render with 'A task must belong to an existing project' (TaskFormServlet.java:50-53); non-numeric -> HTTP 500; NO state check so ARCHIVED projects accepted (ProjectDao.java:45-55)
validation.priority: no servlet validation; defaults MEDIUM when absent/empty (TaskFormServlet.java:58,89-91); arbitrary string -> DB CHECK violation -> HTTP 500 (schema.sql:34-35)
validation.assigneeId: empty -> NULL (TaskFormServlet.java:60-61); non-numeric -> HTTP 500; nonexistent id -> FK violation -> HTTP 500
validation.dueDate: empty -> NULL (TaskDao.java:182-188); malformed ISO date -> IllegalArgumentException -> HTTP 500
validation.description: stored as-is; absent -> NULL, empty string -> empty string (TaskFormServlet.java:57)
validation.status: always OPEN on create (TaskFormServlet.java:66); never changed on edit (TaskDao.java:97-112)

routes.redirect: 302 /tasks/form?id=<savedId>&saved=1; JSP shows 'Saved.' banner when param.saved=1 (TaskFormServlet.java:74; task-form.jsp:29)

methods.POST: param action drives a state machine (TaskActionServlet.java:23-74)

actions.approve: role-gated ADMIN/MANAGER (403 otherwise) + requires current PENDING_APPROVAL else 409; -> DONE (TaskActionServlet.java:48-52; AuthFilter.java:40-46; Role.java:12-14)
actions.reject: role-gated ADMIN/MANAGER (403 otherwise) + requires current PENDING_APPROVAL else 409; -> IN_PROGRESS (TaskActionServlet.java:53-57)
actions.bulkClose: see bulkClose section; no role gate

routes.shared: unknown id -> 404 'No such task' (TaskActionServlet.java:33-36); non-numeric id -> HTTP 500; success redirects to /tasks or /tasks/form?id=<id> when return=detail (TaskActionServlet.java:66-73); each update bumps updated_at (TaskDao.java:115-125)

methods.GET: lists all projects ordered by name with owner join, plus people; forwards projects.jsp (ProjectServlet.java:23-28; ProjectDao.java:19-31)

actions.archive: UPDATE state='ARCHIVED' WHERE id=? AND state='ACTIVE' (ProjectDao.java:75-84); unknown or already-ARCHIVED id silently no-ops then 302 /projects; missing/non-numeric id -> HTTP 500 (ProjectServlet.java:34)
actions.create: name required non-blank after trim else HTTP 400 'Project name is required' (ProjectServlet.java:39-43); description as-is (null if absent); ownerId=session user id; state forced 'ACTIVE' (ProjectServlet.java:44-50; ProjectDao.java:57-72)

routes.roles: no role gate on archive or create; any authenticated user (whole ProjectServlet)

methods.GET: hand-rolled JSON array of all tasks, or filtered by status param (ApiTaskServlet.java:23-49); content-type application/json UTF-8 (ApiTaskServlet.java:29-30)

routes.fields: id,title,status,priority,assigneeId,projectId,dueDate,updatedAt; assigneeId and dueDate emitted as JSON null when NULL (ApiTaskServlet.java:41,43); strings escaped only for backslash and double-quote (ApiTaskServlet.java:51-54); description NOT exposed

auth.sessionCheck: session attr 'user' must be a Person else 302 /login (AuthFilter.java:33-38)
auth.roleGate: only approve/reject on /tasks/action are role-gated to ADMIN/MANAGER, enforced in filter and again in servlet (AuthFilter.java:40-46; TaskActionServlet.java:91-98)
auth.roleModel: ADMIN,MANAGER,MEMBER,VIEWER; canApprove() = ADMIN||MANAGER (Role.java:7-14); role values also CHECK-constrained in schema.sql:14-15

bulkClose.entry: POST /tasks/action action=bulkClose, ids as repeated params (TaskActionServlet.java:76-88)
bulkClose.empty: no ids -> 302 /tasks with zero mutation (TaskActionServlet.java:78-81; TaskDao.java:129-131)
bulkClose.effect: single UPDATE ... SET status='DONE' WHERE status <> 'DONE' AND id IN (...) (TaskDao.java:128-147)
bulkClose.mixedStates: OPEN/IN_PROGRESS/PENDING_APPROVAL all closed; already-DONE rows silently skipped; no count or feedback
bulkClose.roles: no role gate; VIEWER/MEMBER can close PENDING_APPROVAL tasks (defect D-002)
bulkClose.errors: non-numeric id in ids -> HTTP 500 NumberFormatException (TaskActionServlet.java:84)

schema.source: src/main/resources/db/schema.sql (loaded by Postgres container init; app never creates schema, Database.java:12-14)
schema.person: id identity PK; username VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE; full_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL; password VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL; role CHECK in ADMIN/MANAGER/MEMBER/VIEWER (schema.sql:9-16)
schema.project: id identity PK; name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL; description VARCHAR(1024) NULL; state NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' CHECK ACTIVE/ARCHIVED; owner_id NOT NULL FK person (schema.sql:18-26)
schema.task: id identity PK; title VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL; description VARCHAR(4000) NULL; status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN' CHECK OPEN/IN_PROGRESS/PENDING_APPROVAL/DONE; priority NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MEDIUM' CHECK LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH; assignee_id NULL FK person; project_id NOT NULL FK project; due_date DATE NULL; updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP (schema.sql:28-42)

daoMappings.taskBase: JOIN project p, LEFT JOIN person a exposes assigneeName/projectName transient display fields (TaskDao.java:15-20)
daoMappings.nullHandling: assignee_id rs.getLong + wasNull -> null (TaskDao.java:227-228); due_date DATE -> ISO string or null (TaskDao.java:232-233); setNullableLong/setNullableDate write SQL NULL for empty (TaskDao.java:174-188)
daoMappings.technical: findByProject has no web caller (TaskDao.java:31-33); ProjectDao.findById has no web caller (ProjectDao.java:33-43); Database.awaitReady retries 30x1s then RuntimeException (Database.java:42-59); BootstrapListener waits for DB at startup (BootstrapListener.java:10-13); oracle_ro SELECT-only role (oracle-ro.sql:71-75)

seed.people: admin/Ada Admin/ADMIN, mgr/Morgan Manager/MANAGER, dev/Devon Member/MEMBER, view/Vic Viewer/VIEWER; passwords equal usernames (seed.sql:44-48)
seed.projects: 1 Apollo ACTIVE owner 2; 2 Borealis ACTIVE owner 1; 3 Legacy Archive ARCHIVED owner 1 (seed.sql:51-54)
seed.tasks: 1 Design login page OPEN HIGH; 2 Wire up SSO IN_PROGRESS HIGH; 3 Migrate invoices PENDING_APPROVAL MEDIUM; 4 Archive old data DONE LOW; updated_at staggered 3h apart for deterministic default sort (seed.sql:59-63)

projects.jsp: table id/name/description/state/owner; Archive form button only when state ACTIVE (projects.jsp:145-151); Delete link to /projects/delete?id= which has NO servlet mapping -> HTTP 404 (projects.jsp:152 vs web.xml:71-78, defect D-001); create form name/description (projects.jsp:158-170)

TaskStatus.java: stringly-typed status constants OPEN/IN_PROGRESS/PENDING_APPROVAL/DONE, authoritative values in schema CHECK (TaskStatus.java:9-13)
